name: GIRAFFE
aliases: GIRAFFE — Compositional Generative Neural Feature Fields, GIRAFFE Scene Composition
definition: A method representing scenes as compositions of N entities (N-1 objects + 1 background), where each object has a separate feature field and an affine transformation, allowing control over pose, shape, and appearance of individual entities.
summary: GIRAFFE represents scenes as compositions of separate generative neural feature fields for each entity, enabling disentanglement of individual object shapes, appearances, and poses from the background.
